source_message.text:
Hi Elena Rowan, after a day of digging, here is the complete rundown.

The problem went beyond the fake administrator users we found last night. A hidden administrator account was also buried in the database, and around 830 casino spam pages had been published under that account. Code injected into one of your plugins concealed all of this while interfering with the site’s caching, which caused visitor pages to take 15+ seconds to load.

The identified malware and content have now been cleaned up, taking about 7 hours in total today. The work included:
- Removing the hidden administrator account and all ~830 spam pages
- Replacing the compromised plugin with a clean official copy
- Reinstalling WordPress itself
- Working with WP Engine to reset the site’s credentials and keys, while also requesting a full platform-level malware scan for independent confirmation
- Configuring Wordfence to scan for security issues and alert us if suspicious activity returns

Pages now load in under 2 seconds instead of 16. I’ll continue monitoring the site for the next couple of days to verify that it remains clean.

I need you to complete a few steps:
1\. Because the security reset signed everyone out of WordPress, set a new password when you log back in and ask every other administrator to do likewise.
2\. As an additional precaution, change your WP Engine password.
3\. Give me full access to your Google Search Console so I can remove the spam pages from Google before they damage your rankings. Go to Settings > Users and permissions > Add user > Full access and use theo@brightpixel-digital.example.
4\. Submit a quick test through the contact form and confirm that its email arrives, ensuring your leads still flow after these changes.

The remaining work is:
- Cleaning up Search Console once access is available
- Updating the outdated plugins, which were probably the attackers’ original entry point
- Sharing the results from WP Engine when its scan is returned

I’m happy to answer questions. If you would like a formal written report for your records, I can provide one as well.
